scope: Validate a generated executable checker entry against independently required output/declaration leaves (I06–I08). Trusted facts only; no module resolution.

stateVariables.shape: Input family of staged config bytes, including malformed writes.
stateVariables.edges: Decoded references; not scheduling, output attribution or raw compiler inputs.
stateVariables.phase: Prepared, staged, then admitted or rejected.

initialState: Prepared graph; independently required A, B and output O.
assumptions: Each path binds one distinct managed config. Physical paths/compiler options not modeled. A check projection may reference a different checker; inbound check edges from declaration roots are not legal.

safety.CompleteControls: Shared DAG and outbound check exceptions must pass.

liveness: None: no caller or external-process completion guarantee.
fairness: None; terminal stuttering represents quiescence only.

bounds.dimensions: 5 or 8 shapes, 7 files, optional unbound path. Reachability depth bounded by all files.
bounds.pruning: None: no state/action constraints, symmetry or view filtering.

counterexamples: A self-consistent omission is still missing if required by source; scheduling can conceal the loss only in a mutant.
empiricalVerification: Run reference-validation.spec.ts and the cache bridge; inspect actual serialized files.
